subject: planner: Allow prepared and non-prepared queries with set_var and resource_group hints to be cached. (#62367)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: `pkg/planner/optimize.go` no longer sets `StmtCtx.SkipPlanCache` for `SET_VAR` / `RESOURCE_GROUP` hints (including binding-applied hints) and adds a `planner.Optimize` defer to apply `StmtHints.SetVars` on successful optimization so cached-plan paths (prepared and non-prepared) still set + restore session vars. Plan cache already persists/restores `StmtHints` via `PlanCacheValue` (`core.adjustCachedPlan` assigns `stmtCtx.StmtHints = *stmtHints`), and hint text remains part of `PlanCacheStmt.StmtText` used in cache keys. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in planner correctness/semantics for this change.
